words.d: a plan of the things you must do and when
the white bubbles that soap makes in water
opening the mouth wide and breathing in when tired
to sit or lie back comfortably doing nothing
to plan a time for an activity or event
the natural state of rest at night
mud, dust or grime that makes something unclean
to be familiar with something from experience
an informal word for a toilet

videos.desc: Four labeled items lie on the floor representing a full schedule: a textbook 'Revise', a laptop 'Work', a gym backpack 'Gym' and a pillow 'Sleep'. A hand hovers over the choices and, one by one, everything disappears until it grabs the pillow - sleep wins.
videos.said: My schedule is very full, but I choose sleep.

videos.desc: In a sunny courtyard a young woman rubs a soap bar under a brass tap until the white suds in her hands swell into a huge cloud; a man watches open-mouthed and applauds before she rinses the suds down the basin.

A sleepy couple in pajamas stands in a morning kitchen with coffee mugs; the man does a huge stretching yawn, apologizes, and the woman immediately catches it and yawns too — they keep passing the yawn back and forth until even their dog joins in.

Two hamsters lie on a thick white fluffy blanket in a warm, dimly lit room strung with fairy lights. The one on the left wears round glasses and taps at a small silver laptop, still awake and working. The one on the right has a white sheet face mask over its face and a pink bow headband, and lies on its side with its eyes shut, not moving, deep in sleep while the other works on beside it.

A run of people settling into total idleness: a construction worker in a hi-vis vest drops back onto a living-room sofa with his boots up; a woman lies stretched out in a white hammock under palm trees with her hands behind her head; a shirtless man reclines on a striped beach lounger under an umbrella, sipping from a can; a man lies flat in a green field under a blue sky; a woman lounges in a hammock on the sand as the sun sets over the sea.

A woman in a beige blazer works at a huge blank month calendar drawn on a white office wall. She writes in a tabbed spiral notebook on the desk, then presses coloured sticky notes into the empty date squares one after another until the whole month is covered in pink, orange, green and blue notes, and steps back to look at the finished plan.

A young man in a grey vest stands at the door of a yellow-and-turquoise tiled shower and turns the tap. Water pours from the shower head; he holds his hand under the stream to test the temperature and pulls it back. Then he is under the shower himself, bare-chested and drenched, water running down his face and body as he works shampoo into his hair.

A woman in a bright tiled kitchen holds both palms up to the camera, pulling a disgusted face: her hands and fingers are covered in thick dark brown grime. She steps to the white sink, turns on the tap and rubs a bar of purple soap over one filthy palm until white foam builds up. She scrubs the foam between her hands, then rinses both hands under the running water while dark specks wash into the basin. At the end she holds up the bar of soap in one hand and a completely clean pink palm in the other, smiling.

In a small apartment kitchen, a blue passenger train rushes past right outside the tall window, blurred with speed and filling the whole window. A young woman in a green top and black leggings stands barefoot by the counter holding a phone and a mug, turns, and stares at the train with her mouth open. At a small table a bearded young man in a blue T-shirt calmly keeps eating cereal from a bowl, and a tabby cat sleeps on the windowsill beside a potted herb. A pink morning sky shows above the train.

At a muddy music festival at sunset, a young woman with red braids, in a denim jacket, a floral dress and rubber boots, steps away from a makeshift toilet with her arms flung up in triumph and a pained face. Then she turns, bends her knees and pulls a pained face again. The white toilet stands behind her between hay bales and a shower curtain, with a roll of paper on a stick. A line of laughing young people in boots waits and watches, and tents and flags fill the field behind.
